assets.subject: TARGETED REPAIR 1 of this static reading still only. Camera EXACTLY 90 degrees perpendicular overhead, orthographic architectural MAP projection: no visible side faces of soil slab, fence or vehicle, no low-angle/isometric perspective. Compact sculpted CARTOON 3D top surfaces on warm off-white with realistic soil, grass and metal textures matching S1-01. Lower half: large empty safe observation zone. Across its complete width: continuous protective boundary seen from directly above, with no gap into the vehicle route. Upper-right: stationary generic unbadged utility vehicle on intact sandy route, seen directly from above. Upper-left beyond the boundary and clearly OFF the vehicle route: a SMALL SHALLOW partly grass-concealed ground depression, no deeper than the low grass, NOT an excavation, crater, pit or cliff; only subtle dark soil reveal and uneven ground at its edge. A protected clear access route wraps around the right outside edge without crossing vehicle traffic or the depression. No people, mannequins, helpers, hands, rescue, injuries, active vehicle, brand-like markings, school symbols, words, numerals, arrows, fake writing or labels. Leave clean blank margins for later editable four-language callouts. This overhead spatial safety map must differ from every oblique video scene.

Two separate PARALLEL overhead sculpted CARTOON 3D miniature field-shade tableaus on one warm off-white background, consistent with S1-01 but compositionally different from the single eye-level heat and dizzy video scenes. Each vignette contains ONE clearly synthetic faceless full display mannequin with smooth neutral joints, shaded from sun, with a few subtle moisture beads so neither image implies that severe heat illness must have dry skin. LEFT vignette: the mannequin is seated upright by unused cooling cloths and a fan. RIGHT vignette: a separately posed mannequin remains supported in shade beside a BLANK mock-call phone and unused cooling props; the pose only represents an urgent warning scenario and MUST NOT diagnose by itself. The separation gap and blank margins allow editable four-language condition labels later. No actual person, real face, hands, helper, oral drink, medication, patient intervention, thermometer, text, arrows, numbers, brand, logo, pseudo-writing or heatstroke sign inferred solely from sweating. Realistic fabric, soil and plastic textures but clearly sculpted educational cartoon, never photoreal clinical imagery.

A close NEAR-ORTHOGRAPHIC STATIC TABLETOP inventory of UNUSED first-aid training props as a compact sculpted CARTOON 3D diorama on warm off-white, with realistic gauze, tape, blanket, plastic and metal textures and generous clean margins. Composition must not be a crop of the existing first-person open-kit video nor the new split reasoned-choice video: there is NO open kit or split treatment station. Instead lay out sealed clean gauze, a tape roll, folded emergency blanket, a small sealed starter eye-rinse bottle and a genuinely BLANK unlined contact card on a single clean tabletop. In a separate background alcove show a full fixed dual-nozzle eyewash unit visibly piped into a wall, substantially larger than the bottle. The small bottle must not appear to be the entire washing provision. No patient, mannequin, helper, hand, wound, medication, tweezers touching anything, active eye washing, chemical release, printed card lines, words, numbers, arrows, logos, brands, fake text or school identity. Leave space for later editable localized overlay, and keep both near and far objects recognizable.
